title: Community Rules & Site Care Plan Fee and Change Schedule
content:
Each Community Rules & Site Care plan carries the monthly fee and the change terms shown below. The fee is quoted in US dollars per month; the Self-Maintained Site carries no fee.

## Fee, minimum term and availability by plan

| Plan | Monthly plan fee | Minimum term before the plan may be lowered or dropped | Offered at |
|---|---|---|---|
| Self-Maintained Site | $0.00 | none (0 months) | all communities |
| Lawn Mowing Plan | $39.00 | 3 months | all communities |
| Lawn & Trim Plan | $59.00 | 3 months | all communities |
| Full Lawn Care Plan | $84.00 | 3 months | all communities |
| Full Lawn & Snow Care Plan | $119.00 | 6 months | Cedar Hollow and Conestoga Meadows only |
| Complete Site Care Plan | $149.00 | 6 months | all communities |

The minimum term is counted from the plan's last change, and a figure of zero means no minimum applies.

## Terms that are the same on all six plans

| Term | Every plan |
|---|---|
| Day of the month on which that month's plan fee is charged and falls due | the 1st |
| Fewest calendar days between a plan-change request and the first day of the month in which the change takes effect | 15 days |
| Most plan changes in any trailing 12 months | 2 |
| Snow-season months, during which a plan that includes snow removal may not be lowered to one without it | November, December, January, February and March (months 11, 12, 1, 2 and 3) |
| Part-month handling of the plan fee | not prorated: plans start and change on the first of a month and end at the end of the month in which the lease ends |

## Reading the schedule

- **Hypothetical illustration.** A resident who keeps the Lawn & Trim Plan for twelve months is charged twelve monthly fees of $59.00 each, $708.00 in all, each on the 1st of its month.
- **Hypothetical illustration.** Because the fee is not prorated, a month in which a plan is in force carries the plan's full monthly fee; no fraction of a fee is ever charged for a part month.
- The Full Lawn & Snow Care Plan appears in this schedule for every site, but it is offered only at Cedar Hollow and Conestoga Meadows.
